request: Enable available improvements without withholding solely for absent comprehensive evidence; discard observed functional regressions.

design.goal: same current goal binary, all six off plus each of four on alone plus four combined, one full-protocol exploratory run per profile; baseline/shared/memory/dynamic/uncertainty/combined order
design.manual: same current manual binary; baseline and final eligible combination using jitter trace; additional item attribution only when adverse behavior occurs
design.shared: actual ROS positive/negative peer probe and asynchronous view-stamp regression
design.core: existing 36 tests and launch configuration checks

decision_rule: No minimum improvement magnitude. Prior mechanism benefits remain usable evidence; missing dynamic Isaac/multirobot flight alone is not a veto under this request.

Any new collision/external protection/identity failure fails the candidate. New loss of goal arrival or prolonged stall relative to completing baseline is an observed capability regression and excludes the responsible feature.
One-run small timing/jerk differences are reported as observations, not reproducible causal proof; if they determine rejection, run a fixed additional comparison.
Do not erase prior regressions. Current uncertainty/memory implementations have equivalent computation refinements since old adverse trials, so this is reevaluation, not a claim they never regressed.
Keep features independently selectable and retain all failed outputs.
claim_limit: Activation validation with per-feature on/off comparison; no population-level all-metric noninferiority claim.
